remarks: Welcome to 65 Malibu Road, where classic Colonial style meets modern innovation. Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in sought-after North Stamford, this beautifully updated home offers the perfect blend of comfort, efficiency, and community. Inside, sun-drenched living spaces flow effortlessly across hardwood floors, anchored by a renovated eat-in kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a center island built for gathering. Updated bathrooms and generously sized bedrooms-including a serene primary suite-make everyday living both stylish and functional. The finished, walk-out lower level with its own bathroom adds flexible space for a recreation room, guest suite, or home office. But what truly sets this home apart is its brand-new solar power system, dramatically reducing energy costs while boosting efficiency-a forward-thinking upgrade that blends sustainability with everyday savings. Step outside and you'll find an expansive yard framed by large windows, ideal for entertaining or simply unwinding. Beyond the property lines lies a true neighborhood: a peaceful setting with a strong sense of community, where neighbors still wave hello and gatherings come naturally.
